design_notes.two_stage_resolution: P_TeamResolved = Resolve(Blueprint, MemberTemplate, PolicyState, TemplateAutonomyOverlay, InstanceAutonomyOverlay, ExplicitHumanOverride) with ascending precedence blueprint < policyState < template < templateOverlay < instanceOverlay < humanOverride; then P_effective = P_externalHard âˆ?P_capabilityExists âˆ?P_TeamResolved. External facts intersect AFTER team resolution: no Team layer, human override included, can bypass external hard (invariant 35, Â§25.4).
design_notes.precedence_not_monotonic: Â§19.6 anti-pattern honored: layers resolve by precedence, NOT materialized as monotonic restrictions â€?a higher layer (notably human override) may lawfully relax a lower Team deny (invariant 34).
design_notes.envelope_fail_closed: Per-cell Team autonomy envelope = blueprint.autonomyEnvelope âˆ?template.mutationEnvelope (absent/deny â†?âˆ?. Agent overlays (template/instance, leader or member origin) that grant items OUTSIDE the envelope fail the WHOLE resolution: MEMBER_SELF_ESCALATION (invariant 37) / LEADER_OUT_OF_ENVELOPE (invariant 36) â€?typed errors, never silent drops, never resolved around (TaskDoc: 'a Member attempting self-elevation must fail').
design_notes.stored_but_suppressed: Â§19.4: a PolicyState-locked cell suppresses a stored allow overlay that is in-envelope â€?non-destructive: the overlay value is preserved in the cell provenance (cell.team.suppressed) and in the top-level EffectivePolicy.suppressed list with reason 'policyStateLocked'; suppression never loosens and never suppresses deny overlays or human overrides (Â§19.5).
design_notes.leader_vs_human_separation: leader autonomy (origin 'leader', recordId = overlayId) and explicit human override (origin 'human', durable/auditable, not state-gated, no envelope check) are separate provenance lines; every TeamResolvedCell carries {layer, origin, recordId, value, overriddenLower[], suppressed[]} so each effective value is explainable (TaskDoc acceptance).
design_notes.output_discipline: Outputs are deep-frozen lossless-JSON (deepFreeze assert at the output boundary); explanation = one deterministic line per capability cell + a fixed 5-line report header; identical input always yields deeply-equal output (determinism test).
design_notes.unspecified_cells: A cell with no team-layer value resolves to deny with layer 'unspecified' (fail-closed), and stage 2 still records capabilityMissing/externalHardDeny/externalHardRemovedAll notes with removedItems.

deviations_and_decisions: packages/domain/policy/tsconfig.json extends ../../../tsconfig.base.json (three levels up, not the task-suggested ../../) because the package lives one level deeper than the skeleton packages; noEmit: true; include [src, ../test/t4-*.test.ts].

CONTRACTS-MIRROR DECOUPLING (root cause + fix documented in attempt-ledger.txt): the P1-T4-owned packages/domain/tsconfig.json typechecks test/ with an explicit rootDir, and TS6059 forbids contracts .ts sources in that program; contracts ships no built dist and domain declares no contracts dependency (package.json NOT owned by P3-T4), so the bare specifier is unresolvable. The resolver therefore consumes a faithful local mirror (packages/domain/policy/src/contracts-mirror.ts) of exactly the contracts-v1 surface it uses (id rules, TeamSessionId=RootSessionId invariant 9, MemberIdentity composite + invariant-18 scope guard, LEADER_INSTANCE_ID, deepFreeze). Documented deltas: compile-time-only brands erased to plain string aliases (branded values stay assignable); boundary violations throw the policy's own PolicyResolutionError â€?malformed ids as MALFORMED_POLICY_INPUT, cross-scope identity as IDENTITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH (contracts-v1 code string kept, added to the closed POLICY_ERROR_CODES set). The mirror is a strict subset and can be retired when the repo build wiring makes @dsh-agent-team/contracts resolvable.
Input DTOs are plain mutable data (no readonly) â€?the resolver validates by copying into normalized internal state; OUTPUT types are readonly and deep-frozen. This split is documented in types.ts.

No shared test-helper file: each of the 3 test files is self-contained (task constraint: plain-node runner, audited shim surface toBe/toEqual/toBeGreaterThan/toThrow + .not â€?no toContain, no it.each); fuzz uses a fixed-seed mulberry32 (0x5eed positive / 0xf12e negative), never Math.random.

Identity-boundary negative tests now assert PolicyResolutionError (code IDENTITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH / MALFORMED_POLICY_INPUT with exact details) instead of contracts TeamContractError â€?a direct consequence of the mirror decision above; the accepted cross-scope failure semantics (invariant 18) are unchanged.
